'''Patrol lines''' were used by the [[Imperial Core Navy]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Patrol lines generally consisted of [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]], [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|interdictors]], [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruisers]], and [[TIE/rc starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
